Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to delete my green/purple level 4 Digimon, can I then use this effect to play that deleted Digimon card from my trash without paying the cost?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may delete 1 level 4 or lower Digimon. Then, you may play 1 level 4 or lower green or purple Digimon card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
